programs.title: The Last Showgirl
programs.desc: After thirty years, dancer Shelly Gardner (Pamela Anderson) ends her career.For decades, she performed in a strip revue in Las Vegas, which was inspired by French burlesque.The stage, costumes and music are her passion, for which she sacrificed her family life and relationship with her daughter, Hannah (Billie Lourd).She shared her knowledge and experience with beginner friends Marianne (Brenda Song) and Jodie (Kiernan Shipka).One day, however, producer Eddie (Dave Bautista) announces that the show has been canceled.Devastated, Shelly must re-plan her future.A similar fate will befall her friend Annette (Jamie Lee Curtis), a dealer at an arcade.Golden Globe for Pamela Anderson.

programs.title: Gaucho Gaucho
programs.desc: Argentine cowboys from the province of Salta live by their own rules.Teenage girl Guada, raised in this community, wants to become a gaucha woman.Her family supports her in this.

programs.title: You Gotta Believe
programs.desc: A group of baseball players are having the most important season of their lives.For one of the boys, the stakes are even higher - the team fights not only for victories, but also for his father's dream to come true.

programs.title: Veep 7
programs.desc: Preparations for the elections for the President of the United States are underway.Selina is determined to win it.The most dangerous rival turns out to be his former colleague, Jonah.

programs.title: Veep 7
programs.desc: Preparations for the elections for the President of the United States are underway.Selina is determined to win it.The most dangerous rival turns out to be his former colleague, Jonah.

programs.title: One of Them Days
programs.desc: Dreux (Keke Palmer) and Alyssa (SZA) are like lovebirds, they have been friends for years and share an apartment.Their everyday lives suddenly turn upside down when they discover that Alyssa's boyfriend has squandered all their savings - money that was supposed to be used to pay the rent.The girls face a real challenge: in an atmosphere full of funny adventures, they must quickly find a way to get the missing amount and avoid eviction.It quickly turns out that they will be forced to take truly unusual actions to not only save their home, but also put their friendship to the test.

programs.title: Little Emma
programs.desc: A little girl named Emma was raised by animals.Her life is full of warmth and joy until one of her friends discovers the unpleasant truth that she was actually adopted and is not part of their family.Devastated, Emma sets out on a journey to find her loved ones.Along the way, he gathers an extraordinary team, including the clumsy inventor Żółwik Bystrzak, the ambitious scientist Edward Wilk and the brave Weasel Sancho.Together they are looking for a mysterious island which, according to legend, is inhabited by tiny people.

programs.title: Peasants
programs.desc: In Lipce, life goes according to the rhythm of nature.Maciej Boryna, the richest man in the village, decides to take Jagna as his wife.Although the girl prefers colorful clothes and paper cutouts to working in the fields, and there are numerous rumors about her reputation, she cannot resist the temptation.He strikes a deal with Dominikowa, who agrees to marry his daughter to him.Soon there is a grand wedding.However, the bride is not happy.He loves his stepson, Antek, with reciprocity, which quickly becomes clear to his wife Hanka.Boryna's son is not only constantly looking for an opportunity to meet his stepmother, but also, taking pride in his honor, condemns the family to vegetation.Subsequent dramatic events cause the entire community's resentment against Jagna to turn into open hostility.

programs.title: Scott Pilgrim vs. the World
programs.desc: 23-year-old guitarist Scott Pilgrim (Michael Cera) living in Toronto begins dating seventeen-year-old Knives (Ellen Wong).However, he soon meets the antipathetic Ramona Flowers (Mary Elizabeth Winstead), with whom he immediately falls in love.Regardless of anything, he decides to win the heart of the pink-haired stranger.To do this, he must deal with her seven exes, including:popular actor and skateboarder Lucas Lee (Chris Evans), vegan Todd Ingram (Brandon Routh) with extraordinary powers and musician Matthew Patel (Satya Bhabha).His task is made even more difficult by the rejected Knives, who is desperately trying to get her boyfriend back.The picture is based on the comic book series "Scott Pilgrim" by Canadian artist Bryan Lee O'Malley.The title character was played by Michael Cera, known from "Juno" and "Superbad".

programs.title: Stranger Than Fiction
programs.desc: Harold Crick is a lonely clerk who carefully plans each day.One day he discovers that he is constantly accompanied by a mysterious narrative coming from nowhere.A female voice constantly comments on all his actions.A concerned man goes to a psychiatrist, but he cannot determine what may be wrong with his patient.Literature specialist, Professor Jules Hilbert, suggests to Harold that he is the hero of a book by the famous writer, Karen Eiffel.What's worse, the author usually annihilates the main characters of her works.Crick finds the woman and begs her to spare his life.The eccentric artist suffers from a lack of creative inspiration.Despite the support of his assistant, Penny, he has trouble figuring out how to get rid of Harold.He does everything he can to stop the writer before inspiration returns to her.

programs.title: Bastarden
programs.desc: Year 1755, Denmark.The impoverished Captain Ludvig (Mads Mikkelsen) asks the king for permission to establish a colony on his behalf on the barren moors famous for their infertility.If successful, he expects to be awarded a knighthood and property.The aristocrats are outraged by his arrogance and assume defeat, but he receives consent.From then on, every day for Ludvig and his relatives is spent on hard, physical work beyond their strength, which will allow them to prepare the land for cultivation.They also hire people to help them - two runaway servants: Ann Barbara (Amanda Collin) and her husband.Months pass and the first buildings are built when the ruthless Frederik de Schinkel (Simon Bennebjerg), the land lord, tries to take over the moors.When Ludvig rejects his offer, he decides to destroy it.

programs.title: 4 from there
programs.desc: Another installment of the adventures of people living in a town straight from a nightmare.It is a terrifying place that traps anyone who crosses its borders.Desperate residents fight to stay alive.
